user_query: I'm thinking of buying a new smartwatch for myself. Can you suggest some popular models available on Gearbest? Provide me with the product details and shipping options to Colombia. Additionally, recommend some logistics companies that offer fast and secure shipping services.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of popular smartwatches available on Gearbest.
Get detailed information about the selected smartwatches including specifications, prices, and customer reviews.
Check the shipping options for the selected smartwatches to Colombia.
Recommend logistics companies that provide fast and secure shipping services to Colombia.
